description: HARD ground-truth set for RAGAS evaluation. Precise-detail and paraphrased questions with gold reference answers; several target passages that verse-range retrieval struggles to surface, so context recall/faithfulness are expected to be lower than on the easy set.

cases.question: How old was Methuselah when he died?
cases.reference: Methuselah lived nine hundred sixty and nine years (969), and then he died.

cases.question: How many days and nights did it rain during the great flood?
cases.reference: It rained upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

cases.question: How old was Noah when the flood came upon the earth?
cases.reference: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came upon the earth.

cases.question: What did Lot's wife turn into when she looked back?
cases.reference: Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.

cases.question: What kind of animal spoke to Balaam?
cases.reference: Balaam's donkey (his ass) spoke to him.

cases.question: Who were the parents of John the Baptist?
cases.reference: John the Baptist's parents were Zacharias, a priest, and his wife Elisabeth.

cases.question: What words were written on the wall at Belshazzar's feast?
cases.reference: The writing on the wall was MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

cases.question: Who was Abraham's firstborn son?
cases.reference: Ishmael, born to Hagar, was Abraham's firstborn son.

cases.question: Which river flowed out of Eden toward the east of Assyria?
cases.reference: Hiddekel is the river that flowed toward the east of Assyria; the fourth river was Euphrates.

cases.question: How many pieces of silver was Jesus betrayed for?
cases.reference: Judas betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.

cases.question: Who committed the first murder, and who was the victim?
cases.reference: Cain committed the first murder, killing his brother Abel.

cases.question: What did Jesus turn water into at the wedding in Cana?
cases.reference: Jesus turned water into wine at the wedding in Cana.

cases.question: How many days did Jesus fast in the wilderness?
cases.reference: Jesus fasted forty days and forty nights in the wilderness.

cases.question: Who interpreted Pharaoh's dreams in Egypt?
How long was Jonah in the belly of the fish?
cases.reference: Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
